remarks: Location, location, location!  Direct waterfront condo in sought-after Vantage Point complex with amazing water views from most rooms. Enjoy glorious sunsets, panoramic water views and cool summer breezes while relaxing on one of 2 balconies (living/dining & primary BR), overlooking the harbor & Long Island Sound. Reserved carport parking & storage room. Secured elevator building, community room for parties and social gatherings, heated inground pool, marina and dock promenade. New flooring throughout, freshly painted, and ready to move in. Kitchen with eating area, quartz countertops, & stainless steel appliances. Convenient commuter location just minutes from 2 train stations, I-95 & Merritt Pwy, Beaches, SoNo collection mall, shops & restaurants. Come and enjoy the good life and lifestyle that waterfront living offers. Add'l Storage room #S20 on water side of complex. Reserved parking space under building is directly in front of storage room.  Walk/bike to all the amenities 06855 offers. Credit, background reports through RentSpree please and no tenant supplied reports.
